moments.title: Premier League Action This Weekend
moments.blurb: Matchweek 5 of the Premier League kicks off tonight with a London derby, followed by a full slate of games across the weekend.

angles.name: London Derby
angles.copy: Tonight! Brentford take on Chelsea in a fiery West London derby to kick off Premier League Matchweek 5. Who's taking the bragging rights?

angles.name: Weekend Fixtures
angles.copy: The Premier League weekend is here! Arsenal head to Brighton, Spurs host Aston Villa, and Man City face Sunderland. What's your top pick?

angles.name: Local Teams
angles.copy: Big weekend for our local Premier League sides! Catch the action as Everton play Ipswich, Newcastle host Hull, and Nottingham Forest battle Coventry. Get behind your team!

moments.title: Autumn Officially Arrives
moments.blurb: The Autumnal Equinox, marking the official start of astronomical autumn in the Northern Hemisphere, occurs on Wednesday, September 23rd at 01:06 BST.

angles.name: First Day of Autumn
angles.copy: Summer's officially over (astronomically speaking)! The Autumnal Equinox arrives this Wednesday, bringing cooler days and longer nights. Time for cosy jumpers and pumpkin spice everything. #Autumn

angles.name: Changing Seasons
angles.copy: The leaves are already turning, but it's official this Wednesday: welcome to astronomical autumn! What's your favourite thing about the season changing?

moments.title: Women's Rugby World Cup Kicks Off in England
moments.blurb: The Women's Rugby World Cup begins in England this week, with matches including England vs USA in Sunderland on September 22nd and Scotland vs Wales in Manchester on September 23rd.

angles.name: England Home Game
angles.copy: The Women's Rugby World Cup is ON! England take on USA in Sunderland this Sunday. Get ready to cheer on the Red Roses! #RWC2026

angles.name: Scotland v Wales
angles.copy: Big one for the home nations! Scotland face Wales in the Women's Rugby World Cup in Manchester this Wednesday. Who are you backing?

moments.title: Laver Cup Returns to London
moments.blurb: World-class tennis is back in London as The O2 hosts the ninth edition of the Laver Cup from September 25-27, 2026, featuring Team Europe vs Team World.

angles.name: Tennis Showdown
angles.copy: The O2 is ready! The Laver Cup brings Team Europe vs Team World to London this weekend for three days of incredible tennis. Who's your favourite player?

angles.name: London Hosts Tennis
angles.copy: London is once again the centre of the tennis world as the Laver Cup takes over The O2 from Friday. Expect drama, rivalries, and incredible shots!

moments.title: Cosmic Void Festival in London
moments.blurb: The Cosmic Void Festival is taking over London from September 18-20, 2026, offering a weekend of rock and metal.

angles.name: Rock Weekend
angles.copy: Calling all rockers! Cosmic Void Festival is live in London this weekend, bringing three days of heavy riffs and headbanging. Who's going?

moments.title: Equinox Festival in Lincolnshire
moments.blurb: Equinox Festival, a grassroots music and arts event, is currently running in Lincolnshire until September 21st.

angles.name: Festival Vibes
angles.copy: Still got that festival feeling? Equinox Festival is on in Lincolnshire until Monday with live bands, DJs, and workshops. Get those last summer vibes in!

moments.title: AVA Festival London This Weekend
moments.blurb: AVA Festival, an electronic music event, takes place in London from September 24-26, 2026.

angles.name: Dance Festival
angles.copy: Ready to hit the dancefloor? AVA Festival brings the best in electronic music to London from next Thursday! Who's joining the party?

moments.title: Homobloc Returns to Manchester
moments.blurb: The acclaimed Homobloc festival, celebrating queer club culture, is happening in Manchester on September 26, 2026.

angles.name: Queer Clubbing
angles.copy: Manchester! Homobloc is back next Saturday for a massive celebration of queer club culture. Get ready for an unforgettable day and night!

angles.name: Grime Legend
angles.copy: Happy 42nd Birthday to the one and only Dizzee Rascal! From Bow to the charts, he changed the game. What's your favourite Dizzee track?

angles.name: Synthpop Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 64th Birthday to Joanne Catherall of The Human League! Still sounding incredible after all these years. #HumanLeague

angles.name: The Boss's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 77th Birthday to the legendary Bruce Springsteen this Wednesday! Still rocking stages worldwide. What's your ultimate Springsteen anthem?

angles.name: Latin Legend

moments.title: Happy 64th Birthday Tracey Thorn!

angles.name: Everything But The Girl

angles.name: Rap Superstar
